instruction: Two Level Parking And Service Block IFC This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create a Revit parking and service block with two levels, a ramp, and a pedestrian stair, then save the required output in the Desktop as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc. 1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes. 2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 1 IfcSpace, 4 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, and 1 IfcRamp. 5. The IFC model contains at least 1 IfcStair, at least 1 IfcDoor, and at least 1 IfcWindow. 6. The IFC model contains 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcColumn, and 0 IfcBeam entities. 7. The normalized IfcSpace name list contains the token plant at least once. 8. The shaped IFC product bounding-box X span is between 22.0 m and 26.0 m. 9. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Y span is between 14.5 m and 17.5 m. 10. The shaped IFC product bounding-box Z span is between 3.2 m and 4.5 m. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
